transcript.text: I reviewed the county health guidance for the pantry this week, and there are some important requirements we need to add to the draft plan. First, refrigerated food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or colder, and the temperature must be logged every 2 hours while the pantry is open — our current draft only calls for a weekly temperature check, which won't meet the county standard. Second, the guidance requires that sealed packages display allergen labels. I have the printed guidance in my health-office binder if anyone wants to review it directly.

The draft plan currently proposes Wednesday lunch pickup, but that won't be viable for the families we're trying to serve. Additionally, intake materials need to be available in English, Spanish, and Somali — the draft currently only includes English and Spanish. I haven't yet updated the operations sheet with these outreach results, so we should revise the plan to reflect them.
